config.clear_third_person_aim.title: Clear Third Person Aim
config.clear_third_person_aim.preview_hi: Live preview: your changes apply immediately.
config.clear_third_person_aim.preview_un: Open this screen in a world to see a live preview.
config.clear_third_person_aim.option.ena: Master switch. Also toggled by the key binding (unbound by default).
config.clear_third_person_aim.option.tri: Become transparent while drawing a bow.
Become transparent while loading a crossbow.
Become transparent while holding a loaded crossbow.
Become transparent while readying a trident throw.
Become transparent while holding snowballs, eggs, ender pearls, potions and similar items.
config.clear_third_person_aim.option.fro: Also work in the front-facing third person view (camera looking at your face).
config.clear_third_person_aim.option.mod: Full body: everything. Upper body: head, torso and arms (legs stay). Around crosshair: only the part inside an ellipse at the screen center.
config.clear_third_person_aim.option.rem: How much of your model stays visible where it is transparent. 0% = invisible.
config.clear_third_person_aim.option.rad: Horizontal radius of the ellipse, relative to the screen height.
Vertical radius of the ellipse, relative to the screen height.
config.clear_third_person_aim.option.fea: Width of the soft edge of the ellipse.
config.clear_third_person_aim.option.dis: Grow the ellipse when the camera is pushed close to you (your model looks bigger then).
config.clear_third_person_aim.option.hid: Also make the items in your hands transparent. Off keeps your bow visible.
config.clear_third_person_aim.option.for: Debug: always use the simple per-part translucency that is used with shader packs.
config.clear_third_person_aim.option.tra: Instant: switch immediately. Fade: fade in and out smoothly.
config.clear_third_person_aim.option.fad: Time to become visible again (Fade only).
config.clear_third_person_aim.option.ext: Item IDs from other mods that trigger while being used, separated by commas. Example: somemod:longbow
Item IDs that trigger just by holding them, separated by commas.
